en: A vintage, sepia-toned postcard showing a group of armed men in traditional Albanian highland dress, posing in front of a wooden wall. Most wear white fustanella-style garments, embroidered vests, sashes with ammunition, and traditional caps, and carry rifles. One man kneels in the front holding a long staff. The scene is ethnographic, emphasizing traditional costume. French caption text appears at the bottom.
